import html from typing import List # A minimal HTML template for a forum post. # {author}, {title}, {body} and {tags_html} will be substituted safely. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by {author}

{body}
{tags_html}
""" def _escape(text: str) -> str: """ Safely escape text for inclusion in HTML. """ return html.escape(text, quote=True) def _render_tags(tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Render a list of tags as elements, each escaped. """ if not tags: return '' rendered = [] for tag in tags: escaped_tag = _escape(tag) rendered.append(f'{escaped_tag}') return ' '.join(rendered) def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author : str The username or display name of the poster. title : str The post's title. body : str The main content of the post. HTML tags are preserved but attributes are not parsed; only plain text is escaped. post_tags : List[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str The complete HTML snippet for the post, with all user‑supplied data escaped. """ # Escape all dynamic content to prevent XSS and HTML injection safe_author = _escape(author) safe_title = _escape(title) # Body is treated as plain text; escape it to avoid rendering user HTML safe_body = _escape(body) tags_html = _render_tags(post_tags) # Use format_map to avoid accidental replacement of braces in content html_snippet = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author=safe_author, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags_html=tags_html ) return html_snippet.strip()
